title: Liberal Media Wants You To Know: They Knew Eric Swalwell Was A Sex Pest, And Didn’t Report A Thing
summary: The article discusses recent sexual assault allegations against Rep. Eric Swalwell (D-CA) and highlights claims from various media and political figures who assert they were aware of his inappropriate behavior for years but chose not to report it. This raises significant ethical concerns about the responsibility of journalists and political insiders to protect potential victims by disclosing such information, as critics argue that their silence may have endangered women. The situation underscores the complexities of accountability within political circles and the media's role in addressing misconduct.
